Gzip compression format, ported from gz.go.

Backend is our own gzipf/flate (RFC 1951/1952, zero-copy in, reusable output buffers): no external compression dependency. Magic 1f 8b, default level when 0, multistream unless disabled.

Imports

../gzipf, ../io, ../types, ../registry

Types

Gz = object
  compressionLevel*: int     ## 0 means DefaultCompression (like Go)
  disableMultistream*: bool
  multithreaded*: bool       ## accepted for API parity; encoder is single-threaded

Consts

gzMagic = [0x1F'u8, 0x8B'u8]
